title: coding-agent-attempt/1: one coding agent's attempt at a matched leaf in data/evaluation/coding-agent-attempts.jsonl
description: One row per attempt of a matched run: the same Ready leaf, brief and base commit given to a routing row's first choice and to one challenger, each in its own worktree. The two rows of a pair share issue, base commit and kind of work. The procedure and how to read the rows are on docs/operations/model-routing.md. `model` and `effort` are the names the curator and player-host configurations use; `wall_seconds` is the run ledger's.

issue.description: The GitHub issue of the leaf both attempts were given.

kind_of_work.description: The routing table's row for this leaf, its first cell verbatim.

base_commit.description: The commit both worktrees started from.

coding_agent.description: The coding agent that ran the attempt, as the coding-agent hosts page names it.

coding_agent_version.description: The coding agent's version as it reports it.

model.description: The model identifier the coding agent was given for the attempt.

effort.description: The effort the attempt ran at, in the hosts' shared vocabulary; null when the coding agent exposes no effort setting.

date.description: The day the attempt ran, as YYYY-MM-DD.

acceptance.description: The result of the lead's own rerun of the brief's acceptance check on the attempt's final commit, whatever the attempt reported.

repairs.description: Repairs the lead had to ask for before the rerun passed, or before giving up.

wall_seconds.description: Wall time from handing over the brief to the attempt's last hand-back, repairs included.

blind_preference.description: The clean-context reviewer's verdict on this attempt's diff against its pair's, read under neutral labels and mapped back afterwards.

outcome.description: Whether the lead merged this attempt or discarded it.

false_report.description: What the attempt reported that was not so, such as a timeout reported as success or quoted text that exists nowhere in the tree or its cited source; null when its report held.
